parameters.name: multivalues
parameters.description: If lldpctl outputs an attribute multiple time represent all values as a list. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
# Retrieve switch/port information
- name: Gather information from LLDP
  community.general.lldp:

- name: Print each switch/port
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ lldp[item]['chassis']['name'] }} / {{ lldp[item]['port']['ifname'] }}"
  with_items: "{{ lldp.keys() }}"

# TASK: [Print each switch/port] ***********************************************************

# ok: [10.13.0.22] => (item=eth1) => {"item": "eth1", "msg": "switch2.example.com / Gi0/3"}
